_comment: Glossary from the ID document (appendix C). Shown as tooltips for bold terms (ticket C-03).

terms.node: One item in a tree, holding a value.
terms.root: The node at the top of the tree. Every search starts here.
terms.child: A node directly below another node.
terms.parent: The node directly above another node.
terms.leaf: A node with no children: a dead end.
terms.subtree: A node together with everything below it.
terms.binary search tree: A tree where each node has at most two children, smaller values are on the left and larger values are on the right.
terms.stack: A collection where you can only add to the top (push) and take from the top (pop). Last in, first out.
terms.push: Put an item on top of a stack.
terms.pop: Take the top item off a stack.
terms.depth-first search: Exploring a tree by going as deep as possible along one path before backing up to try another.
terms.visit: The moment DFS takes a node off the stack and looks at it.
terms.backtracking: Going back to the most recent node that still has an unexplored child.
terms.traversal: Visiting every node in a tree once, in a set order.
terms.pre-order: Write a node down before its subtrees.
terms.in-order: Write a node down between its left and right subtrees.
terms.post-order: Write a node down after both of its subtrees.
